title: Fruza Double Menthol 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Created for those who love a pure and powerful Menthol, Fruza's Double Menthol is a clean, crisp, and intensely refreshing vape. It delivers a punchy, brisk Menthol taste from inhale to exhale, with a sharp, cooling character that’s both simple and deeply satisfying. The Fruza shortfill range is crafted for vapers seeking clear, intense, and authentic flavours. Inspired by Japanese precision and artistry, each e-liquid features a double concentration of flavour, designed to provide a rich and punchy taste experience. With a 50% VG / 50% PG blend, this e-liquid is formulated for MTL vaping. It’s ideal for use with Starter vape kits and pod mods, producing dense, satisfying clouds and exceptional flavour clarity. This 100ml shortfill is supplied in a 120ml bottle, containing 100ml of 0mg e-liquid. This leaves the perfect amount of space to add two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to create 120ml of 3mg nicotine-strength e-liquid. All Fruza e-liquids are made in the UK, TPD-compliant, and feature a childproof cap and a tamper-evident seal for your safety.
